beginner.headline: Robert Pattinson Will Be the Next James Bond
beginner.brief: Robert Pattinson will play James Bond after Daniel Craig. The British actor is known for Twilight and The Batman. Amazon MGM Studios announced the news on social media on Monday. Pattinson is 40 and will be the seventh actor to play Bond. The next Bond film is planned for 2028. Denis Villeneuve will direct the film, and Steven Knight will write it. The film's title and exact release date have not been announced yet. Pattinson said he was excited to work with the team.

intermediate.headline: Robert Pattinson confirmed as the next James Bond
intermediate.brief: Robert Pattinson, known for Twilight and The Batman, has been confirmed as the next actor to play James Bond. Amazon MGM Studios shared the news on social media on Monday, alongside a picture of Pattinson as 007. At 40, Pattinson becomes the seventh actor to take the role of the famous fictional spy. The 26th Bond film is due to be released in 2028. Denis Villeneuve will direct the film, while Steven Knight will write it; its title and exact release date remain unknown. The choice follows years of speculation about who would take over from Daniel Craig in this closely watched role. Amazon MGM chose a household name, selecting a star widely seen as a reliable choice who could bring financial success. Pattinson became famous as Cedric Diggory in Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire in 2005. Together, his five Twilight films earned more than $3 billion worldwide at the box office, meaning income from cinema ticket sales. He is also respected in the film industry for taking roles in smaller, independent and experimental films. Reports suggested he had agreed to make three Bond films, but this deal has not been officially confirmed. The film will also be the first Bond release since Amazon took creative control of the series.

advanced.headline: Robert Pattinson Named Bond as Amazon Gains Creative Control
advanced.brief: Robert Pattinson, known for Twilight and The Batman, has been selected as the next James Bond. Amazon MGM Studios revealed the casting in a social media post accompanied by an image of Pattinson as 007. The 40-year-old will become the seventh actor to portray Bond, with the next film scheduled for 2028. Denis Villeneuve will direct and Steven Knight will write the film, although its title and exact release date remain unannounced. The casting follows years of speculation surrounding one of entertainment’s most highly scrutinised roles. Amazon MGM chose an established, bankable star who is widely regarded as a safe pair of hands. Pattinson’s fearlessness, self-deprecating wit and ability to reinvent himself were praised as qualities that suit him to Bond. Although reports suggested that his agreement committed him to three films, that detail has not been officially confirmed. Pattinson first rose to prominence as Cedric Diggory in the 2005 film Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire. His five Twilight films alongside Kristen Stewart collectively earned more than $3 billion worldwide. He has also earned respect for taking roles in smaller productions, including experimental and arthouse films. In 2025, Barbara Broccoli and Michael G Wilson agreed to sell creative control of the franchise to Amazon MGM. The Broccoli family had controlled the series since 1962, when Sean Connery first appeared as Bond. For decades, the family protected the character’s integrity while resisting spin-offs and licensing. Some industry experts expect these forms of expansion to follow Amazon’s takeover. By the time the next Bond film is released, seven years will have passed since No Time To Die, the longest gap in the franchise’s history.
